title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Team

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Role Summary

Fanatics Collectibles is seeking a Supply Chain Analyst who will support the day-to-day warehouse and logistics operations for the Topps Brasil online store (br.topps.com). Reporting to the Supply Chain Manager, this role will work closely with the e-commerce, operations and finance teams to manage order flow, inventory, transportation and supplier coordination.

Topps Brasil is in a period of rapid growth and digital transformation. As our e-commerce business expands, we are strengthening the operational foundation needed to deliver a reliable customer experience. We are looking for an energetic, hands-on problem solver who works with urgency and is motivated by continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage the order backlog, identifying issues and coordinating timely resolution.

• Monitor shipments and transportation orders through delivery.

• Maintain accurate inventory records and support inventory control activities.

• Track and manage consigned materials.

• Monitor service-level KPIs and highlight operational risks or performance gaps.

• Coordinate the movement and delivery of products required for marketing activities.

• Identify and implement improvements to logistics and supply chain processes.

• Work with suppliers to ensure required information and documentation are complete and accurate.

• Request quotations, issue purchase orders and maintain accurate purchasing records.

• Follow up with suppliers to ensure agreed deadlines are met.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent higher-education qualification.

• Previous experience in logistics, supply chain or warehouse operations is preferred.

• I ntermediate English proficiency.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

• Strong organization, attention to detail and follow-through.

• A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and the ability to work with a sense of urgency.

 

T he above list of job duties is not exclusive or exhaustive and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks as may reasonably be expected within the scope and grading of the post.

Subject to applicable laws, Fanatics Collectibles may choose to run a background check.

title: Project Manager
description:

We’re #1 in our space, growing rapidly, and having fun while doing it. We’re looking for a dynamic Project Manager to help our customers implement and optimize our platform efficiently and successfully.

As a Project Manager at Impartner , you will guide customers through the implementation of our PRM platform, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives. title: Discovery Call Specialist
description:
Modern Thyroid Clinic is the leading thyroid specialty healthcare provider in the United States. For over ten years, we have helped patients - most of them women navigating long, difficult health journeys - finally get answers and feel like themselves again, earning well over 600 five-star reviews across multiple platforms.

The Discovery Call Specialist is the first human voice prospective patients meet. This person conducts complimentary discovery calls (held via Zoom) with individuals who have reached out to learn more about our care. The goal of these calls is not to enroll people; it is to listen, build trust, answer questions clearly, provide reassurance, and help each person determine whether Modern Thyroid Clinic is the right fit for them. When it is the right fit, the Specialist warmly invites the prospective patient to begin their care.

This role requires high empathy, a kind and gentle demeanor, strong communication skills, and the ability to guide a meaningful conversation with purpose and care - never pressure.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct complimentary discovery calls with prospective patients over Zoom, with the camera on.

• Listen first and create a safe, supportive space in which each person feels seen, heard, and respected.

• Build trust through warmth, patience, and genuine care.

• Clearly explain how telehealth care works, what it costs, what to expect, and what makes our providers different.

• Provide reassurance to individuals making a vulnerable, important decision about their health.

• Guide each conversation toward the right outcome for the patient - helping them find their best fit, even when that fit is not with us.

• For prospective patients for whom our care is right, warmly invite them to begin care with the clinic.

• Apply a consultative, question-led approach to onboarding that builds confidence rather than applying pressure.

• Represent the mission, values, and culture of Modern Thyroid Clinic in every interaction.

Required Qualifications

•
Prior relevant experience conducting discovery calls and/or helping patients or clients make positive, confident decisions about their care or wellbeing. (Candidates without this experience will not be considered.)

•
Prior experience in consultative onboarding - a question-led, trust-based approach to guiding people through a decision.

• Excellent verbal communication skills; articulate, warm, and clear.

• Comfortable and polished showing up for work on Zoom with the camera on .

• High empathy and the emotional maturity to hold space for someone's fears and hopes with grace.

• Ability to connect easily with people who are struggling, particularly women navigating difficult health journeys.

• Must be able to work full-time, 40 hours per week (this is not a part-time role).

• Must be authorized to work in the United States and able to be verified for employment through E-Verify .

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with a consultative, question-led sales or decision-guidance philosophy, such as the approach taught by Jeremy Miner.

• A personal connection to health challenges. (Many of our team members and clinicians were once patients themselves. A thyroid condition - or any condition - is not required.)

Work Schedule & Arrangement

• Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday .

•
Moderately flexible scheduling within standard business operations.

• Fully remote / telehealth.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a professional, distraction-free environment suitable for video calls are required.

What We Offer

Modern Thyroid Clinic is a culture-first company. We treat each other with respect - no pettiness, no gossip - and we actively support, train, and develop our team. Our average employee tenure exceeds five years, with team members who have been with us since our earliest days. For many of us, this is more than a job; it is a mission we believe in because we have seen the results firsthand.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sierra’s AI agents depend on foundation models to reason and act in real time. The Inference team builds the systems that make those models fast, reliable, and efficient at scale.

- Build across a hybrid inference stack. Work with both Sierra-managed infrastructure and leading inference platforms, making architectural decisions about where and how workloads should run.

- Push the serving stack forward. Work closely with inference providers to tune engines and infrastructure for Sierra’s workloads.

- Support the broader model lifecycle. Contribute to infrastructure that enables post-training while partnering closely with our Models and Agent Runtime teams.

- Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale production systems.

- Strong judgment around tradeoffs involving latency, reliability, capacity, and cost.

- Experience taking ownership of complex infrastructure from architecture through production operation.

title: Senior Process Engineer Philippines Only
description:
The client is a health benefits platform serving individuals, families, and small businesses across all 50 states. The company acts as its own search engine, broker, and third-party administrator, offering Major Medical insurance and healthshare memberships alongside a consultative approach built around transparency and finding members the right plan at the right price.
We are hiring a Senior Process Engineer to extend our process engineering capability, not just our execution capacity. This is a genuinely autonomous role: you'll be pointed at a business area (claims, billing, enrollment, customer experience) and own the full cycle: diagnose, design using Six Sigma/Lean methodology, implement, and prove the result with a number.
You'll report directly to our EVP of Operations, a Six Sigma Black Belt himself, and work the same way, with the same toolkit, on real operational problems with real budget and real visibility.
What this role is not

• Not a role where someone else has already scoped the fix; you find root cause yourself

• Not a people-management role at the outset (though scope expands as trust and results build)

• Not a call center, inbound support, or scheduling role

Why this role
Real ownership of funded, meaningful projects, not a documentation or facilitation-only seat. A direct line to an EVP who applies Six Sigma at the executive level, and a clear path for scope to expand as trust builds.
Responsibilities
What independence actually means here
This is the single most important requirement, more important than certification level:

• You find and engage the right stakeholders yourself. No contact list handed to you.

• You diagnose the true root cause, not the symptom that got reported.

• You design the fix using DMAIC, 5 Whys, fishbone, process mapping, and validate it before you build.

• You implement it yourself, coordinating everyone across the company needed to make it real.

• You're given a target, not a detailed brief, and you're expected to produce a working result.

If you've only ever executed someone else's pre-scoped plan or facilitated someone else's workshop, this isn't the right seat. If you've independently run RCA and driven a fix from diagnosis through adoption, this is built for you.
What you'll actually own in the first 90 days
Five concurrent workstreams: two with a design already scoped for you to build (onboarding/communications rollout, proactive claims-status communication), and three where you diagnose from scratch (a full CX manual-process audit, a claims call-volume root-cause deep dive, and an open enrollment risk assessment). Yes, that's an aggressive load for a first 90 days; we say so directly, and there's a built-in Day 30 checkpoint to re-sequence honestly based on real velocity. We're not looking for someone who needs that spelled out in more detail than a target and a deadline.
Requirements

• Six Sigma Black Belt strongly preferred (Lean Six Sigma Black Belt a plus); candidates with equivalent independent RCA/DMAIC leadership experience are encouraged to apply

• 8+ years in process improvement, industrial engineering, or business operations

• A track record of independently leading RCA/DMAIC projects from diagnosis through implementation, not facilitating someone else's plan

• Strong process mapping and documentation skills (Visio, Lucidchart, or similar)

• Comfortable partnering with a data analyst to turn raw data into dashboards, SLAs, and metrics. You don't build the pipeline, but you know what a good metric looks like

• Excellent written and spoken English; you'll present directly to U.S.-based leadership

• Full availability across U.S. Central Time business hours

• Healthcare, insurance, or benefits experience is a plus, not a requirement; strong business/digital/remote-work experience is an acceptable substitute

• Possess a laptop/desktop meeting minimum specifications: 16GB RAM, i7 operating system.

• Able to maintain a distraction-free home office setu

description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

THE ROLE

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

- Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

- Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

- Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

- Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics,

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack — Dots
description:
About the Team

Dots is building personal AI agents that help people make progress on their goals, including when they are away from ChatGPT. These agents can learn preferences, maintain context, work across applications, and use cloud computers to carry out tasks.

Our team brings together product engineering, design, and research to turn frontier model capabilities into useful everyday experiences. We are defining how people delegate work, understand what an agent is doing, and stay in control. Engineers help shape both the product and the systems behind it, from early prototypes through launch and iteration.

About the Role

We are looking for Senior and Staff Full Stack Software Engineers to build Dots product experiences from the interface through the services that power them. You will help define how people delegate tasks to personal agents, follow their progress, and collaborate with them over time. This role combines hands-on product development with the systems work needed to make persistent, asynchronous agent experiences reliable.

In this role, you will:

- Build and launch features across web interfaces, APIs, backend services, and data models.

- Create workflows for task creation, progress updates, agent feedback, and results that remain coherent across sessions and devices.

- Translate emerging model capabilities into product prototypes with research, product, and design partners.

- Design clear interfaces between product surfaces and agent execution systems.

- Improve performance and reliability across the stack, including user-facing latency and recovery from partial failures.

- Own projects from early exploration through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration based on user feedback.

- Help establish technical direction, testing practices, and observability as the product grows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have significant experience building and shipping products across frontend and backend systems.

- Can move comfortably between user interfaces, service design, APIs, and data modeling.

- Bring strong product instincts and care about making complex capabilities understandable to users.

- Have taken ambiguous ideas from concept to production and made practical tradeoffs between iteration speed and long-term maintainability.

- Understand asynchronous workflows and can reason about state, consistency, and failure across system boundaries.

- Collaborate effectively with design, product, research, and engineering partners.

- Have owned complex engineering projects and helped other engineers make sound technical decisions.

- Experience launching new consumer products, building agent or workflow applications, or working in small teams with broad engineering ownership is especially relevant.

- Prior experience with AI or machine learning is helpful, but not required. We welcome experienced engineers who want to bring strong product and engineering judgment to a new category of software.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
We’re a ~40 person company building the OAuth/OpenID Connect platform that large digital banks and regulated industries run their identity on. Our stack is Java on Google Cloud, delivered as a shared multi-tenant service, dedicated single-tenant clusters, and a self-managed product customers run themselves.
This is a hands-on builder role, not a management or pure-compliance role. You’ll build our security program from the ground up: writing the policies, shipping code fixes, wiring detection into GCP, and setting the practices the rest of engineering follows. You’ll lean on AI to move fast, researching how the best companies do this, drafting policies, reviewing code, and hunting vulnerabilities at a scale a lean team otherwise couldn’t reach.
What you'll do

• Stand up our vulnerability management program end to end: intake, triage, severity, remediation targets, security advisories, and coordinated disclosure, across both our managed and self-managed deployment models.

• Build our product security incident response (PSIRT): on-call, playbooks, and AI-assisted triage that turns High/Critical CVEs into paged incidents automatically.

• Work hands-on in the codebase, contributing security fixes to our Java platform and raising the bar on secure coding, secrets and key management, and hardening.

• Build proactive detection and response in GCP: alerts, monitoring, and automation where it pays off.

• Integrate security into CI/CD and IaC: dependency and container scanning, Terraform checks.

• Own our external security posture: security.txt, a security contact, a public trust page, and a security white paper.

• Get ahead of frontier-AI offensive tooling (the Mythos class of AI-discovered zero-days) by pointing AI agents at our own code before someone else does.

• Partner with platform engineers on security-relevant architecture and lead its security dimension.

• Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls pragmatically alongside engineering, without the role becoming audit admin.

What we're looking for

• A hands-on security engineer who codes. You’re comfortable reading and writing code (Java, Go a strong plus), Terraform, and GCP configs, not just reviewing others’ work.

• Strong application security foundation: secure coding, vulnerability management, security in CI/CD.

• Cloud security depth on GCP, IAM, Kubernetes, infrastructure hardening.

• Incident response experience: investigations, detection tooling, and clear communication with customers or regulators.

• You’re energized by owning the whole spectrum at a small company rather than going narrow at a large one.

• Bonus: OAuth/OIDC, FAPI, or identity-security background; ISO 27001 or SOC 2 exposure.

Why Join Us

• Own security for a platform used by large financial and regulated customers

• Work closely with founders, engineering, and customers

• Modern, cloud-native environment without unnecessary overhead

• Competitive pay and flexibility

Members API
Stable, semantic endpoints exposing member profile, identity, peer discovery, and graph relationships. The foundation of member experience.
Chapters API
APIs powering chapter management, forum operations, event discovery, and role-based data access across YPO 's global regional structure.
Agentic Ecosystem APIs
Governed API contracts for AI agents (Peer Discovery, Event Discovery) built on OpenAI + RAG and Google Gemini. Agents consume only approved APIs. Agent reasoning must always be surfaceable.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. API Design & Implementation

• Design and implement production-grade RESTful and GraphQL APIs deployed via AWS API Gateway that are stable, semantic, and decoupled from vendor-specific backend schemas.

• Adopt a serverless-first approach using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge where appropriate, selecting stateful services only when serverless patterns are genuinely insufficient.

• Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code across the Members, Chapters, and Agentic Ecosystem API domains.

• Define and enforce data models, versioning standards, authentication flows (Auth0 / Okta / OAuth 2.0), and integration patterns from first principles.

• Apply performance-aware design intentional pagination, caching strategies, query constraints, and rate-limiting so APIs scale safely under real-world load.

• Every API decision must reinforce member trust through privacy-first architecture, consent enforcement, and transparent data usage.

• Ensure every API response includes provenance and explanation metadata, so agent reasoning is always surfaceable to the member.

2. Agentic Ecosystem Engineering

• Implement the API governance layer that controls how YPO 's AI agents (Peer Discovery, Event Discovery) interact with member data on OpenAI + custom RAG and Google Gemini.

• All agent-facing APIs must support structured retrieval, citation-ready provenance fields, consent-aware filtering, and deterministic fallback.

• Build and maintain kill-switch-capable API boundaries that prevent agents from ever consuming raw member data outside approved contracts.

• Instrument agent API integrations with feedback loop mechanisms hallucination rates, task success rates, and cost-per-outcome metrics must be observable and attributable to specific API behaviors.

title: Estimating Administrative Assistant
description:
Estimating Administrative Assistant

• Work Type: Full-time.

• Schedule: Standard US business hours, with occasional overtime and weekend work required based on bid schedules and workload demands.

• Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview
We are seeking an organized and proactive Estimating Administrative Assistant to provide critical day-to-day support to our estimating department. In this role, you will focus on internal team organization, data entry, and correspondence management, ensuring that Senior Estimators and the Estimating Team Lead can operate efficiently and without administrative bottlenecks. The ideal candidate is highly reliable and brings a detail-oriented approach to maintaining documentation and supporting departmental coordination.
Key Responsibilities

• Data Management: Enter new project data, client information, and bid outcomes accurately into the company CRM or project management software.

• Quote Organization: Receive, log, and organize incoming material and subcontractor quotes, ensuring they are placed correctly into designated project files for the estimators.

• Correspondence & Documentation: Draft, format, and proofread proposals, cover letters, and follow-up correspondence under the direct guidance of the estimating team.

• Post-Bid Support: Assist in compiling critical post-bid documentation and seamlessly transitioning awarded project files to the operations team.

• Department Support: Provide comprehensive administrative assistance by answering department phone calls, managing shared email inboxes, and supporting coordination efforts between operations, sales, and estimating leadership.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Experience: 1-2 years of professional administrative experience.

• Technical Proficiency: Strong basic computer and software proficiency, including experience with data entry and inbox management.

• Core Competencies: Exceptional attention to detail, reliability, and a highly professional work ethic. Proven ability to follow established processes and direction accurately. Must be able to pass a pre-employment screening.

• Remote Infrastructure: Must have a dedicated, noise-free home office setup equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.

Preferred Qualifications (Bonus):

• Basic familiarity with construction terminology and industry workflows.

Benefits of Working for Hyre

• Performance-based raises.

• Minimum 5 days off annually (paid or unpaid based on client terms).

• Annual cost-of-living adjustments at your one-year anniversary.

title: Emerging Talent Recruiter
locationText: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, our recruiting team is the driving force behind building a world-class organization. We are passionate, innovative, and deeply committed to finding exceptional talent that fuels our mission. By collaborating with leaders across engineering, operations, and technology, we shape and execute hiring strategies that are as dynamic and forward-thinking as the company itself. Our team thrives in a fast-paced environment, setting the standard for excellence, creativity, and strategic talent acquisition-ensuring that every new hire contributes to Anduril's continued success.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Technical Recruiter to join our Emerging Talent Recruiting team that will support our Hardware/Software teams. Based in our Costa Mesa, CA office, you will operate independently as a subject matter expert, ensuring we recruit top-tier talent and shape our long-term talent strategy. As a key member of Anduril's recruiting team, you will be responsible for the company's talent management as we continue to rapidly grow. Your work will be hands-on and involve collaborating with leaders and individual contributors to define the hiring needs of the company. To achieve this, you will be given the autonomy and tools to execute on our strategy to build and develop Anduril's world class team. We are looking for someone who can handle high levels of ownership while tackling every aspect of recruiting and is excited to be part of small team where no task is too big or too small.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Operate Autonomously: Serve as a trusted talent advisor for complex hiring across Emerging Talent in Hardware.

• Develop and optimize recruiting strategies using prospecting techniques, tools, and automation to continuously improve candidate management and data extraction processes.

• Collaborate closely with the emerging talent team, program managers, coordinators, hiring managers, and senior leadership to shape recruitment strategy, guide process improvements, and drive high-impact, complex hiring projects.

• Leverage a deep understanding of university recruiting and trends related to hiring.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS :

• 5+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in university recruiting and tech.

• Demonstrated leadership in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with a focus on strategic stakeholder alignment.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a track record of influencing organizational best practices.

• Ability to travel to execute university recruiting trips and events as needed

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in startups, tech, and relevant hardware domains.

• Ability to work independently with little supervision.

description: De opdracht Van veranderkundig advies naar daadwerkelijke verandering. Daar ligt jouw opdracht. Voor twee veranderopgaven binnen het sociaal domein van de gemeente Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren senior implementatiemanager die veranderkundige expertise combineert met implementatiekracht . Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Dan ben jij de senior implementatiemanager die we zoeken voor de ondersteuning van de teams Wet Maatschappelijke Ondersteuning (Wmo) en Jeugdgezondheidszorg (JGZ) binnen het Sociaal Domein. Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten. Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, managementteams, medewerkers en interne adviseurs. title: GTM Strategy & Operations, APAC Lead
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a GTM Strategy & Operations Lead, you will be a founding member of our GTM Strategy & Operations team, embedded as the strategic partner to the sales leaders running our APAC sales organization.

You will own segment performance alongside those leaders: the strategy behind the number, the operating cadence and tactics that drive it, and the analysis that explains what is working and what is not. From forecasting and pipeline management to territory design, capacity planning, quota and incentive structures, and go-to-market strategy, you will touch nearly every lever that makes a sales organization perform.

This is a high-visibility seat at the center of the business. The role is a direct path to a deep understanding of commercial strategy and operational excellence in a high-growth environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Partner directly with Enterprise, Mid-Market and BDR leadership to define segment strategy, growth priorities, and execution plans.

- Translate company-level goals into segment targets, operating plans, and measurable KPIs.

- Own the forecast for your segments: run the cadence, pressure-test the calls, and give leadership a defensible view of where the quarter lands.

- Lead high-impact analyses that inform critical decisions across pipeline health, conversion, capacity planning, segmentation, incentive design, and headcount investment.

- Build the financial and operating models used to evaluate trade-offs and quantify the impact of GTM decisions.

- Own territory and account coverage design, quota setting, and the mechanics that make both defensible to reps and leadership.

- Design and run the core business cadences that create accountability: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and QBRs.

- Build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership visibility into performance, productivity, and pipeline generation.

- Establish the metrics that distinguish top performers, diagnose the root causes of underperformance, and scale what works across the team.

- Improve Salesforce and the surrounding GTM stack so data integrity, workflow efficiency, and reporting keep pace with the business.

- Project-manage cross-functional initiatives spanning Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Engineering & Product, Finance, Recruiting, and Operations.

- Find novel ways to use Factory droids to automate the reporting, analysis, and deal support work that would otherwise consume the team.

- Roll up your sleeves on immediate problems while building the long-term infrastructure, and present clear, structured recommendations to senior leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 4+ years of professional experience, ideally in consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or a high-growth startup.

- Strong analytical skills: You go deep on data and structure analyses quickly to answer the business question at hand. You know the data underneath your work, including where it comes from, how it's built, and where it falls short. You can defend your numbers and have a point of view.

- Ownership: You take initiative, drive problems to the finish, bring in the right people at the right time, and hold yourself accountable for the outcome.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Data Science team is growing at 9fin! We are doing world-class work with groundbreaking technologies to build data-driven products using machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, speech and audio, and knowledge/data mining. We are looking for a AI Engineer to accelerate our application of AI across teams and products. Come and join us, you will get to build large-scale AI powered systems, learn and apply the latest techniques, and work alongside other great researchers and engineers!

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

- Design and build generative AI applications tailored to complex financial and legal workflows, leveraging state-of-the-art models to deliver innovative, practical solutions that streamline decision-making and unlock new efficiencies.

- Drive end to end model development lifecycle, leading the team in best practices, ensuring reproducible research and well managed model delivery/deployment.

- Collaborate cross functionally to share diverse ideas, understand business problems, and elevate/mentor your teammates.

- Translate complex problems into well-defined scoped bets in an internal startup style environment, dynamic and fast-paced.

- Learn and apply ground-breaking research and approaches in advanced topics, iterating improvements with a fail fast mentality.

- Be a proactive sharer of compelling ideas/work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout 9fin.

ABOUT YOU

This role will be a great fit if you:

- Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery.

- You’re an expert in any of the following areas - deep expertise in one and familiarity with others is ideal:

- Information Retrieval: chunking strategies, (finetuning) embedding models, training re-rankers.

- Entity/relationship extraction/resolution

- Knowledge Graphs; building and inference, graphRAG

- Recommendation systems and ranking: personalisation, learning-to-rank, feed ranking, user modelling, etc.

- Tabular ML: feature engineering, structured data modelling (GBDTs, etc.)

- Statistical & Predictive Modelling: supervised ML, anomaly detection, temporal modelling, etc.

- Deep understanding of the GenAI landscape and agentic frameworks.

- Experience working in the full model lifecycle (including experimentation, training, testing, monitoring, and deployment). We are data centric and love our evals!

- You have a strong product focus with a desire to understand the end-to-end impact of your solutions for our end users.

- Good knowledge of AWS’s AI infrastructure.

BENEFITS

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

- Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

- Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

title: Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

We are seeking an experienced Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one.

Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.

What you’ll do as a Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA at Vanta:

- Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts

- Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment

- Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta

- Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles

- Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy

- Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy

- Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment

- Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region

How to be successful in this role:

- Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots

- Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.

- Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region

- Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

- Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it

- Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

- Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

- Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

- Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change

- Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses

About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Global People function are looking for an experienced HR Business Partner to join them.

We have a team of dedicated and talented professionals, taking responsibility for all “people” aspects of the business. This includes the whole employee life cycle, from attracting new joiners, on-boarding, development throughout their career, ensuring they work in a balanced and healthy way, supporting them when needed, enabling efficient and effective processes throughout, every day, for their entire journey at Baringa. 

As we continue to grow organically, we need to ensure our people offerings are set up to enable the future size and shape of the business to operate effectively and efficiently, using the appropriate tools. Supporting the ever-evolving business needs and being a key player in the change management of the firm, is a core part of this role.

Position: National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH) Volunteer

About RAINN

Since 1994, RAINN (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network) has helped millions of people affected by sexual violence and we're just getting started. As the nation's largest anti-sexual violence organization and operator of the National Sexual Assault Hotline (1-800-656-HOPE), we lead the fight against sexual violence by expanding prevention, ensuring justice, and providing healing to create safer communities.
Our mission is to stop sexual violence by supporting survivors, holding perpetrators accountable, and creating safer communities and we do it through three pillars:
Prevention - Educating the public and inspiring action through media, entertainment, and direct outreach
Justice - Leading bipartisan policy campaigns and working to hold every offender accountable
Healing - Providing free, confidential, 24/7 support through the National Sexual Assault Hotline, DoD Safe Helpline, and other programs
Volunteers are at the heart of this work. By joining RAINN , you become part of a movement that has answered millions of calls, shaped national policy, and given hope to survivors across the country.
If you or someone you know needs support, free and confidential help is available 24/7: call 800.656.HOPE (4673), chat at rainn.org, or text HOPE to 64673.
Position Summary
The National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH), operated by RAINN , provides live, secure, anonymous crisis support to the growing number of people who prefer communicating online through a simple instant message format, giving those affected by sexual assault a safe place to receive support.
NSAH volunteers are responsible for providing high-quality services to users of the National Sexual Assault Hotline, including but not limited to survivors of sexual assault and their loved ones. Volunteers also receive extensive and ongoing crisis-intervention training as well as professional development and coaching opportunities.

title: Strategic Account Director – PSU/Government
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?
If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
About the Role:
Kong is the AI Connectivity Company. We build the infrastructure that lets enterprises govern APIs and AI traffic at scale - and that infrastructure is becoming critical to how India's government and public sector modernize their systems.
We're hiring an Account Executive to own a defined patch of PSU (Public Sector Undertaking) and Government accounts across India. You'll work the full government buying cycle - tenders, GeM listings, System Integrator relationships, empanelment - to bring Kong 's platform into major public-sector modernization programs.
This role is based in Delhi and reports to a Country Manager.
What You'll Do:

• Own the sales cycle, government-style. Lead deals from first conversation through RFP response, technical and financial bid submission, and contract award. Track PQ (pre-qualification) criteria, EMD requirements, and L1 bidding dynamics. Keep your pipeline accurate to what's actually documented in the tender process - not what looks good in a forecast.

• Work the ecosystem, not just the account. Government and PSU deals rarely close direct. Build real relationships with the System Integrators (SIs) and OEM partners who carry the technical bid, and make sure Kong is positioned - and empanelled - before the tender drops.

• Navigate multiple stakeholders. IT Secretaries, CTOs and CIOs at PSUs, nodal officers, procurement and finance committees - each has different priorities and a different definition of "done." Map them accurately and plan around all of them.

• Build account plans for your patch. Identify which departments and PSUs are actively modernizing, where their budget cycles sit, and what a realistic path to close looks like. Then execute against it.

• Get fluent in the platform and the landscape. Know Kong 's API and AI governance platform well enough to defend it in a technical bid, and know where competitors are already empanelled.

• Meet your number. Consistently hit quota. Government cycles are long - consistency across quarters matters more than any single deal.

• Bring in the rest of Kong early. Loop in sales engineering, legal, and the channel team before compliance and certification requirements (STQC, data residency, MeitY empanelment) become a bottleneck late in the deal.

• Travel. Expect real time in government offices and PSU sites across India. This is a relationship business, and relationships in this sector are built in person.

What You'll Bring:

• 8-12 years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology sales, with direct experience selling into Indian government departments or PSUs. This isn't optional - the public-sector buying process is different enough that generalist enterprise experience alone won't carry you.

• A track record of consistently hitting quota (typically in the ₹2-5 Cr / $300K-$750K range) sold through longer, multi-stakeholder government cycles.

• Working knowledge of India's government tendering lifecycle - GeM, RFP/RFI processes, technical and financial bids, PQ criteria, EMD - and how empanelment with bodies like MeitY or NIC actually works in practice.

• Established relationships with System Integrators and OEM partners active in India's public-sector technology space.

• Process discipline and patience. Government deals move on their own timeline. You bring structure to that timeline - you don't try to force it.

• Executive presence with senior government officials and PSU leadership , along with the judgment to know when to push and when to wait.

• Ownership with collaboration. You run your patch, but you know when to pull in your manager, sales engineering, or a partner. In the public sector, this isn't a solo sport.

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at .

About the Role:
We are seeking an SME for Data Center Commission and Quality. This role demands direct knowledge of data center construction, with a strong focus on MEP systems.
Working directly with CoreWeave project coordination members, you will ensure projects across the CoreWeave portfolio are completed on time and to the highest quality standards.
Responsibilities include overseeing the installation and testing of components and systems, including mission-critical systems such as generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution equipment, redundancy protocols, and cooling systems such as chillers and CDUs.
This is a remote-eligible position with 50% travel required. Candidates must reside in or near the Northern Virginia, Dallas, Richmond, Virginia, Livingston, New Jersey, or Atlanta, Georgia regions.
What You'll Do:

• Operate with safety at the forefront of all construction initiatives.

• As necessary, collaborate with general contractors, trade partners, and vendors.

• Serve as a liaison between clients and internal teams, facilitating communication during commissioning activities.

• Review all written documentation, commissioning, and quality-related information.

• Assist in developing, reviewing, and implementing commissioning plans as needed.

• Assist in coordinating and attending pre-construction commissioning meetings.

• Attend construction progress and pre-installation job-site meetings to gather relevant information.

• Review meeting minutes for necessary revisions and assist in resolving design-intent discrepancies.

• Inspect field installations and witness functional tests; conduct site visits as necessary.

• Witness the execution of commissioning tests.

• Travel to sites, client meetings, and training as required.

• Participate in developing reports that define project progress, problems, and solutions for leadership teams and clients.

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of experience in MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) commissioning, with a preference for experience in data centers or critical facility environments.

• Comprehensive understanding of data center infrastructure, including Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), and complex MEP building systems.

• Familiarity with local building codes and industry-standard frameworks, including NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and ASHRAE .

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook) and experience with industry-standard commissioning software or digital platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining high organizational standards and meeting strict project deadlines.

• Self-directed professional with a proven track record of driving complex processes to completion and ensuring accountability across the project lifecycle.

• Ability to develop and maintain effective professional relationships with contractors, clients, and cross-functional internal teams.

• Direct experience in the coordination, commissioning, or quality assurance of electrical and low-voltage equipment.

• Possession of a valid driver’s license and a motor vehicle record that meets company insurability standards.

• Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time and the ability to respond to emergency communications outside of standard business hours as required.

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at the time of employment.

title: Practice Director - Application Security
description:

At AHEAD , we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD .
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD .

The Practice Director - Application Security leads the growth, performance, and ongoing development of AHEAD ’s Application Security practice. This leader is accountable for building executive client relationships, creating and advancing sales opportunities, shaping services and go-to-market strategy, and developing a high-performing team. The role partners closely with AHEAD sales teams and other practices to bring clients integrated security solutions that address business and technology risk.

The position is weighted approximately70% toward sales and practice managementand30% toward delivery leadership. The Director brings deep expertise in application security, DevSecOps, cloud-native security, and secure software delivery, and applies that expertise to advise clients, differentiate AHEAD ’s offerings, and ensure successful outcomes on selected strategic engagements.

Role Allocation

• 30% - Delivery leadership:Executive client advisory, engagement oversight, delivery quality, risk management, and selective hands-on or lead delivery for strategic engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Practice Management - 70%

• Build and execute the Application Security practice growth strategy, translating market needs and AHEAD priorities into a focused portfolio of services and go-to-market plans.

• Develop trusted relationships with client executives and technology leaders; identify business priorities, security challenges, and opportunities to expand AHEAD ’s impact.

• Partner with sales specialists to qualify, shape, and advance opportunities from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and transition to delivery.

• Lead client discovery, visioning, and solution-design sessions; communicate the business value, approach, scope, outcomes, assumptions, and investment for proposed services.

• Drive new partnerships with industry-leading AI development and security technology partners.

• Identify opportunities to combine Application Security services with cloud, infrastructure, data, AI, and other AHEAD capabilities to deliver integrated client outcomes.

• Guide service positioning, packaging, repeatability, and supporting sales materials; ensure offerings remain aligned with client needs and current technology and market trends.

• Build and develop the practice team through hiring, talent development, coaching, mentoring, and succession planning;

title: AI/ML & Intelligent Automation Lead
description:
Take AI/ML from demo to daily use on a federal health program. As the AI/ML Intelligent Automation Lead you will lead capabilities from data preparation through inference, evaluation and monitoring, building on the program’s FHIR and OMOP data pipelines. Integrating commercial AI/ML services counts, original model development is not required, and no generative-AI or AI-Native certification is needed. Working knowledge of SAFe is expected, but SAFe certification is not required.

Location: Reston, VA (onsite preferred). Primarily remote within the US, considered for highly qualified candidates, with frequent travel to Reston.
Clearance: US citizen able to obtain and maintain an ADP II clearance.
Remote candidates: you will be required to keep your camera on during the interview, and your interviewer will take your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.

This is in anticipation of future work!

What you'll do

• Lead delivery of AI/ML and automation capabilities into production and operational pilots.

• Build automated data preparation and integrate model-serving or inference APIs, including commercial services. Support low-latency clinical inference and natural language processing use cases, and use feature stores where appropriate.

• Define evaluations and testable acceptance criteria, and keep capabilities version-controlled and monitored in operation, and follow Government AI governance and PHI-handling requirements.

• Work with the architects on data contracts, and with cyber security on hosting, monitoring and security of AI services.

• Document models, data pipelines and evaluation results so the Government can sustain them. Deliver through iterative backlogs, demo results, and act on user and operational feedback in a SAFe delivery framework using the Government’s Azure DevOps.

What you bring

• Bachelor’s in computer science, data science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, health informatics or a related field with 8-12yrs. of prior relevant experience.

• 8+ years in software engineering, data engineering or applied analytics, including 3 implementing or integrating AI/ML. The 8 years need not all be in AI/ML.

• At least one AI/ML capability delivered into production or an operational pilot used by end users, covering automated data preparation, model-serving or inference-API integration, evaluation, version control and operational monitoring. Research-only or demo-only experience does not qualify. Experience with health or other regulated data is preferred.

• Experience building on cloud AI/ML services in AWS GovCloud or an equivalent government cloud environment, and with CI/CD and model-versioning (MLOps) practices.

• Agile delivery experience: iterative backlogs, testable acceptance criteria, results demos, and incorporating user and operational feedback , with working knowledge of SAFe and Azure DevOps (certification not required).

• Ability to meet the applicable Government work-role requirements: Ability to meet the applicable Government work-role requirements: Government designated training for HIPAA Compliance, Information Assurance and applicable background investigation.

• Knowledge of MHS/DHA environment , such as MHS GENESIS, the Joint Health Information Exchange, and DoD-VA data exchange.

We’re building a new way of doing things: simpler, more transparent, and more human. We’re looking for bilingual people who want to be part of Nu’s international expansion and help build a world-class customer experience operation from the ground up.

title: Talent Coordinator
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE TALENT ACQUISITION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Deploy AI across the entire funnel. Use the latest models in every part of talent ops to find the best people in the world faster than any team has before. You won't bolt AI onto old processes; you'll rebuild recruiting around it.

- Treat talent as the critical path. Every role we can't fill slows the whole company down. We need to figure out how to move faster than everyone else in market without ever dropping the bar; one wrong hire costs more than a slow one.

- Build a brand the best want to join. Make Fluidstack a name top talent seeks out, not one we have to chase. You'll shape how the world's best engineers and operators hear about us, and why they say yes.

 

ROLE SCOPE

- Own interview coordination end to end: schedule and manage complex, multi-stakeholder interviews across formats, time zones, and roles with zero dropped balls.

- Deliver a white-glove candidate experience as the primary point of contact through the interview process, responsive and clear at every touchpoint.

- Keep the machine running: anticipate and resolve scheduling conflicts, logistical issues, and process bottlenecks before they become problems.

- Maintain data integrity: own accurate, up-to-date candidate records and workflow tracking in the ATS.

- Support the TA team operationally, partnering with Partners and Sourcers on the tasks that keep pipelines healthy and hiring moving.

- Spot friction in the process, flag it, and help build better workflows, leaving every system better than you found it.

- You communicate with precision, so candidates, hiring managers, and teammates always know where things stand.

- You keep clean data and have a low tolerance for errors, because clean systems produce better outcomes.

title: Recruteur - Freelance H/F
description:

Nous prônons la bienveillance, l'excellence et la culture du résultat.
Pour soutenir notre croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Recruteur(se) Freelance pour alimenter en continu notre pipe de candidats qualifiés, en lien direct avec le Responsable Recrutement.
Ton rôle : sourcer, préqualifier et évaluer les meilleurs talents pour nos clients.
Si tu es passionné(e) par le sourcing et la chasse de talents et que tu veux rejoindre une agence de recrutement en pleine structuration, ce poste est fait pour toi !
🎯 Tes missions:
En lien étroit avec le Responsable Recrutement, tes missions seront les suivantes :
Sourcing & chasse

• Tu définis et affines ta stratégie de chasse (mots-clés, canaux, ciblage).

• Tu chasses activement des profils sur LinkedIn, notre ATS, nos bases de données candidats et tout autre canal pertinent.

• Tu rédiges et envoies des messages d'approche, en volume et en qualité et tu suis tes relances.

• Tu traites quotidiennement les candidatures entrantes dans notre ATS.

• Tu es force de proposition sur les canaux : si la chasse sur les outils existants ne donne pas les résultats attendus, tu ne te contentes pas de constater le blocage, tu proposes activement de nouvelles pistes (nouveaux réseaux, groupes, communautés, plateformes, approches multicanal).

• Tu te maintiens à jour sur les meilleures pratiques de sourcing dans l'écosystème infopreneur/digital : tu sais où se trouvent les bons profils, et où ils se trouveront demain.

• Tu es orienté(e) solution : quand le vivier est mince, tu cherches comment le débloquer, tu arrives avec des solutions, pas des problèmes.

Préqualification

• Tu mènes les préqualifications téléphoniques pour les profils chassés afin de valider les critères clés : disponibilité, motivations, compétences de base, adéquation avec le poste.

• Tu rédiges une synthèse concise et exploitable pour chaque profil présenté au Responsable Recrutement : points forts, points de vigilance, éléments factuels observés, critères validés/non validés et recommandation argumentée

• Tu ne transmets que les profils qui passent le filtre : la qualité de ce qui remonte est de ta responsabilité.

Entretiens :

• Tu conduis en autonomie les premiers entretiens sur les rôles opérationnels.

• Tu utilises la trame d'entretien préparée en amont.

• Tu évalues rigoureusement : compétences, soft skills, adéquation culturelle, motivation réelle.

• Tu creuses au-delà des réponses superficielles ou incomplètes : tu vas chercher des faits et du concret, tu n'hésites pas à challenger les profils sur les points essentiels.

• Tu envoies une synthèse au Responsable Recrutement avec des recommandations claires.

Relation & suivi candidats

• Tu es le premier point de contact des candidats : tu présentes le poste et le contexte, tu réponds aux questions, tu vérifies l’adéquation avec le profil.

• Tu assures un suivi actif des candidats tout au long du process : relances, mises à jour, coordination des disponibilités.

• Tu organises les entretiens avec le Responsable Recrutement pour les profils validés.

• Tu donnes un retour qualitatif, personnalisé et constructif à chaque candidat non retenu.

• Tu prends des références sur les profils avancés dans le process, avant présentation au client.

• Tu veilles à ce qu'aucun candidat ne reste sans nouvelles : l'expérience candidat est l’un des piliers de Golden Hire .

Reporting & visibilité

• Tu partages proactivement tes actions : le Responsable Recrutement est informé de l'avancement de la chasse au fil de la semaine (profils contactés, réponses reçues, entretiens planifiés).
